articles.title: Could you survive The Oregon Trail? An emergency medicine doctor offers tips on how to not die in the great outdoors - The Conversation
articles.description: Medicine and technology may have advanced, but the dangers of the wilderness remain unchanged. The Oregon Trail game provides timeless tips on how to enjoy nature safely.
articles.content: If you grew up in the United States in the 1980s or 90s, chances are you remember The Oregon Trail. For many like me, it was our first computer game and our first introduction to wilderness survival.… [+8597 chars]
